qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Safety-critical valve actuators and flow control equipment embedded in customer Approved Vendor Lists (AVLs); high switching costs and >24% recurring service revenue support 30%+ ROCE and >20% operating margins.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). While Rotork is a high-return niche leader in actuators with >30% ROCE, ~45% of group revenue remains tied to Oil & Gas midstream and upstream capex. Macrotrend 4 (Energy Transition) poses an active long-term terminal headwind to fossil fuel pipeline and extraction infrastructure, capping competitive advantage period at 10 years.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue £777.3m, with Oil & Gas at £351m (45%), Water & Power at £223m (29%), and CPI at £203m (26%). ROCE was 38.4% in FY2025 (37.3% in FY2024), adjusted operating margin 24.6%, cash conversion 101%, with £125m+ net cash. High capital efficiency, but secular terminal headwinds on 45% oil/gas exposure limit CAP.
